sections.name: LocalUsersAndGroups (conceptual)
sections.description: In Intune you typically manage this via Settings Catalog or Account Protection profiles. Below is intent, not a literal CSP paste.
intendedBehaviour: Remove ad-hoc local admin grants from shared devices.
Retain a single managed break-glass account if policy allows (often LAPS-managed).
Block students from elevation paths that depend on cached creds on shared machines.

sections.name: WindowsLAPS (directional)
sections.description: If you use Entra-joined devices, LAPS for Windows is the least awful way to avoid shared static passwords.

sampleSettingIdeas.idea: Enable LAPS policy for Entra-joined devices

sampleSettingIdeas.note: Teach helpdesk to read the password from the right blade — people still screenshot it.
